signal_text: A Gumroad help center article on Gumroad Discover (dated July 22, 2024) states that to be eligible for the Discover mobile app, products cannot be free and cannot exceed $100 in sales price; all app sales are final with no refunds from Gumroad or sellers; refund requests for in-app purchases must go to Apple or Google; and there is a 40% fee for all in-app sales.
subject_exact: Gumroad Discover mobile app eligibility requirements (price $0.01-$100), no-refund policy, and 40% in-app fee
local_qualifiers: cannot be free or have a sales price greater than $100
not including credit card processing fees or PayPal fees
extraction_notes: Three distinct claims combined from same source passage: price eligibility range for Discover app, all-app-sales-final policy, and 40% fee rate. Refunds for in-app must go to Apple/Google, not Gumroad.
